name: ASTEEL
recent: ASTEEL 于 2026 年 10 月完成董事会改组，Datuk Clifford Hii Toh Leong 在收购后出任执行副主席。公司于 11 月提议多元化进入 IT 服务与贸易业务，并已获得 RM350 万的首笔订单。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收环比增长 25.6%，净利环比大幅增长 397.5%。
notable: Datuk Clifford Hii Toh Leong 在收购后获委任为执行副主席，董事会及多个委员会同步改组。
公司提议多元化进入 IT 服务与贸易业务，并已获得 RM350 万的首笔订单。
2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收环比增长 25.6%，净利环比增长 397.5%。
risks: 董事 Datuk Clifford Hii Toh Leong 的持股出现变动（2026 年 10 月 7 日公告）。
公司于 2026 年 10 月 16 日出现在马股动量股名单中。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 MYR 80,574,000，环比增长 25.6%，同比增长 19.8%；净利为 MYR 1,368,000，净利率 1.7%，环比及同比均增长 397.5%。

recent_en: ASTEEL completed a board reshuffle in October 2026, with Datuk Clifford Hii Toh Leong appointed Executive Deputy Chairman after a takeover. In November, the company proposed diversifying into IT services and trading, having secured an initial RM3.5 million order. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 25.6% QoQ and net profit jumped 397.5% QoQ.
notable_en: Datuk Clifford Hii Toh Leong was appointed Executive Deputy Chairman after a takeover, alongside a broad board and committee reshuffle.
The company proposed diversifying into IT services and trading, and has secured an initial RM3.5 million order.
For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 25.6% QoQ and net profit rose 397.5% QoQ.
risks_en: A change in Director Datuk Clifford Hii Toh Leong's interest was announced on 7 October 2026.
The stock was listed among Bursa Malaysia momentum stocks on 16 October 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 80,574,000, up 25.6% QoQ and 19.8% YoY; net profit was MYR 1,368,000 with a net margin of 1.7%, up 397.5% QoQ and YoY.
